@{65e53dfbf897545663236251|full_name} Try disabling IPV6 in your network settings, it solved the problem for me a couple minutes ago. 

Control Panel

Network and Internet

Network and sharing center

where it says connections: Ethernet 

click on ethernet

click on properties

disable Internet Protocol version 6 (TCP/IPv6)

You shouldn't have to restart your computer

hopefully that solves it.
